program: swap [ [ add ] swap cons ] map swap quote [ over uncons swap drop swap map cat ] fold uncons drop
notes: Stages: map xs to adders (x add), then fold them over the accumulator (ys . out). Each step copies the head ys, maps the adder over it and cats the row onto out; uncons drop then removes ys. The fold body is 7 atoms because each step must copy ys out of the accumulator, map it and append it. Brute force found no 4- or 5-atom fold body, and no chain of two 4-atom instructions, that makes a row per x.
